# `state/commit/CorrectionGate.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/commit/CorrectionGate.js`

state/commit/CorrectionGate.js — correction is NOT authority.  Tiered policy (the layer law for repair): VISUAL    state may auto-correct (particles, cache, chunk, network-with-confidence) SEMANTIC  state must verify before applying (inventory, save, ...) SECURITY  state must NEVER silently repair (permission, ownership, security)  When unsure: branch / quarantine / request authority — never silently fix. Resonance (nearestAttractor) may SUGGEST the repaired value, but acceptance is decided here, and a security tier can only escalate, never apply.
